title: Make Wigglytuff Angry, and It Becomes 20 Times Bigger
premise: When angered, Wigglytuff inhales and can grow 20 times larger.
audiencePromise: Watch Wigglytuff turn anger into a giant balloon threat.
openLoop: How does anger turn a soft body into a giant threat?
payoff: Wigglytuff's elastic body becomes enormous specifically to intimidate opponents.
engagementQuestion: Is Wigglytuff cute, or an intimidating balloon?

voice.instructions: Use a surprised, playful tone with quick pacing. Hit the anger trigger, pause before the size reveal, then land the final choice clearly.

scenes.headline: ANGER MAKES IT HUGE
scenes.narration: Angry Wigglytuff can become 20 times bigger.
scenes.caption: ANGER TRIGGERS A GIANT CHANGE

scenes.headline: SOFT BODY. BIG SECRET.
scenes.narration: Its soft, rubbery body reacts when anger takes over.
scenes.caption: SOFT AND RUBBERY

scenes.headline: THEN IT SUCKS IN AIR
scenes.narration: It inhales with all its might, then steadily starts to inflate.
scenes.caption: ANGER → INHALE → INFLATE

scenes.headline: TWENTY TIMES LARGER
scenes.narration: At the biggest point, Wigglytuff can be 20 times larger.
scenes.caption: SMALL WIGGLYTUFF → 20× SIZE

scenes.headline: THE SIZE IS A WARNING
scenes.narration: That enormous size intimidates opponents, turning anger into a threat.
scenes.caption: INFLATION BECOMES INTIMIDATION

scenes.headline: CUTE OR TERRIFYING?
scenes.narration: Is Wigglytuff cute, or an intimidating balloon?
scenes.caption: CUTE BALLOON OR GIANT THREAT?
